_comment: Hand-maintained repo-level metadata. The skills[] array in MANIFEST.json is NOT edited here or there - it is generated from SKILL.md frontmatter by tools/build-manifest.py. Skill names in the version history below are the names as they were at the time of that release.
description: Shared skills library for Claude, Hermes, and other agents

2.2.0.changes: Added tvv-escalate-blocked-fetch (grow-up fix: web_url_read returned 403 bot-detection on eBay, and the response was to declare it unreachable and pivot to a substitute source instead of trying the already-available Playwright browser tools, which worked immediately once the user suggested it). Also documents using page.evaluate() over browser_snapshot for data extraction, since a full snapshot on a content-heavy page can exceed the tool's max-token output.

2.1.1.changes: grow-up fix: tvv-sync-skills didn't fire on casual phrasing like "update skills with agents-skills" — required a clarifying question to resolve to this repo. Added agent-skills/agents-skills/update skills/sync skills triggers and a naming note to tvv-sync-skills SKILL.md.

2.1.0.changes: Added tvv-tue-business-case-dashboard (build/update interactive HTML business-case dashboards from TU/e pptx/docx source decks, with strict hidden-slide exclusion and citation-free output).

1.3.0.changes: Added ops-infra, ops-pipeline, arch-api-design, check-release, arch-adr, arch-spec (adapted from imserhatdemir/Claude-Skills)

1.4.0.changes: Added verify-external-target (grow-up fix: RoomSense TU/e rebrand shipped guessed brand colors/font/shape twice before verifying against tue.nl's actual live CSS)

1.5.0.changes: Manifest drift fix: dropped azure-functions-deploy and azure-swa-deploy entries (deleted in 244023a but still listed); corrected sync-skills and infra-script-authoring versions to match their SKILL.md frontmatter; standardized repo path on ~/AI-Projects/agent-skills

2.0.0.changes: BREAKING: every skill renamed with a tvv- prefix, so invocation is unambiguous against builtin skills of the same name. Per-skill metadata (version, category, scope, triggers, status, dates) moved into SKILL.md frontmatter; MANIFEST.json skills[] is now generated from it by tools/build-manifest.py and verified in CI. Repaired frontmatter in 6 skills whose unquoted descriptions made them invalid YAML.

removed.name: azure-swa-deploy
removed.reason: Recreated as a Claude builtin with the same content
